Disney World Park Itinerary

May 16 – 22, 2026  |  Optimized for Toddlers
4 Adults + 2 Kids (Ages 2 & 4)  |  One Park Per Day  |  Saratoga Springs Resort & Spa

Day 1 — Arrival & Disney Springs

Saturday, May 16  |  Check-In & Evening Stroll
Travel day — take it easy. Drop bags at SSR early (bell services will hold them before 4 PM check-in), let the kids decompress, then walk the footbridge over to Disney Springs for dinner and a gentle evening.
🌡️ 95°F high / 73°F low — Feels 99°F
💧 Humidity: 65%
☔ Isolated PM t-storm (15%)
🏠
By 3:00 PM

Arrive at Saratoga Springs

Disney’s Saratoga Springs Resort & Spa — 2BR Villa, Preferred
Bell services can hold luggage before official 4 PM check-in. Grab resort maps, pick up the MagicBand kit, and head to the villa once the text with room number arrives. Preferred location keeps you close to the Carriage House and main pool.

2BR Villa (sleeps 8)
Two bedrooms + pull-out means everyone gets a real bed. Stock the kitchen with basics (Instacart/Amazon delivery is easy at SSR). Let the kids burn off travel energy on the balcony or the nearest leisure pool while adults unpack.

Day 2 — Magic Kingdom

Sunday, May 17  |  Fantasyland & Adventureland Focus
Rope drop strategy: Disney resort guests can enter 30 min early. Head straight to Fantasyland via the castle hub — Peter Pan’s Flight first, then sweep counterclockwise. Save Tomorrowland for late afternoon when crowds thin.
👥 Crowds: 1/10 — Very Low
🌡️ 97°F / 74°F — Feels 102°F (hottest day)
💧 Humidity: 71%
☔ Isolated PM t-storm (10%)
💰 Day est: ~$400–500
Heat strategy: Trending warmer than normal — plan indoor rides (Pirates, Small World, Haunted Mansion) during peak heat 2–4 PM. Carry frozen water bottles — they’ll melt into ice-cold water by midday. Free ice water at any QS counter.

Day 2 Summary

10 rides — Peter Pan, Mermaid, Dumbo, Carrousel, Pooh, Haunted Mansion, Big Thunder (Rider Switch), Pirates, Jungle Cruise, Buzz, PeopleMover
3 meals — Artist’s Palette (breakfast) + Columbia Harbour House (lunch) + Casey’s Corner (dinner)
Must-Eat snacks: Sleepy Hollow fruit waffle sandwich (afternoon) + Casey’s hot dogs (pre-fireworks on Main Street)
Key tip: Casey’s Corner is Mobile-Order only at peak times — queue the order from the stroller. Backup TS: Liberty Tree Tavern (book March 19). Day ends with Happily Ever After fireworks at 9 PM — pack noise-reducing headphones for the toddler.
Rider Switch available: Space Mountain (44″), Big Thunder Mountain (40″), and Tron (48″) — one adult rides while the other waits with the kids, then swap without re-queuing.

Day 3 — EPCOT

Monday, May 18  |  World Celebration & World Showcase
Resort Early Entry at 8:30 AM — tap in at the front gate, walk straight through Spaceship Earth, then over to Test Track in World Discovery. Test Track is 40″ minimum, so the 2-year-old sits out with one adult while the other 3 adults + 4-year-old ride (verify the 4-year-old’s height at the entrance marker first). Sweep World Nature/The Land while World Showcase is still closed (opens 11 AM), then enter Showcase clockwise from Mexico → Norway (Frozen) → France (Ratatouille). Frozen will hit 60–90 min by early afternoon — grab a Lightning Lane for it if you can.
👥 Crowds: 7/10 — Heavy (busiest day)
🌡️ 93°F / 70°F — Coolest park day
💧 Humidity: 65%
☔ Rain: Very low (6%)
💰 Day est: ~$450–550
Heat strategy: EPCOT is the most exposed park — World Showcase has long outdoor walks with little shade. Use Journey of Water splash area to cool the kids. The Land and The Seas pavilions are fully air-conditioned rest havens. Pack a compact umbrella in case an isolated PM shower pops.

Frozen Ever After

World Showcase — Norway
THE headliner for your crew — Frozen music, Elsa, Anna, Olaf, boat ride with two mild drops. No height requirement. By 2 PM the standby line is typically 60–90 min; if you grabbed a Lightning Lane, use it here. Otherwise eat the wait — this is the highlight of the trip for the kids.

5:00 PM — Free Time

Wander World Showcase & Casual Dinner

World Showcase Lagoon Loop
~4 hours until the show — let the kids set the pace. Browse the pavilions (Kidcot stamps in each country), grab dinner where moods land: Regal Eagle Smokehouse (American BBQ, kid-friendly), Sommerfest (German pretzels & brats), Katsura Grill (Japanese rice bowls), or just snack-crawl the booths. Alternative: bus back to Saratoga Springs for a nap and return for Luminous by 8:30 PM.
Flex

9:00 PM — Nighttime Spectacular

Luminous: The Symphony of Us

World Showcase Lagoon
EPCOT’s nighttime show: drones, fireworks, and floating barges across the lagoon. Best toddler-friendly viewing: along the Showcase Plaza promenade between Mexico and Canada (open sightlines, easier exit). Bring noise-reducing headphones for the 2-year-old. Slip out a few minutes before the finale to beat the post-show crush.

Day 3 Summary

9 rides — Spaceship Earth, Test Track (3 adults + 4yo), Nemo, Living with the Land, Figment, Journey of Water, Three Caballeros, Frozen, Remy’s
2 meals + flex dinner — Artist’s Palette (breakfast) + Sunshine Seasons (snack/light lunch) + casual Showcase dinner
Key tip: Use Resort Early Entry at 8:30 AM to clear Spaceship Earth + Test Track before official open. Frozen Ever After Lightning Lane is the highest-value pickup of the day — Norway’s standby peaks 1–3 PM. Day ends with Luminous at 9 PM.
Test Track height min (40″): The 2-year-old can’t ride — one adult sits out with them. Verify the 4-year-old clears 40″ at the entrance marker before queuing. With 4 adults, no Rider Switch needed unless the sit-out adult wants a turn — in which case use Rider Switch to swap them in after the first ride cycle.

Wednesday, May 20  |  Toy Story Land & Animation Focus
Rope drop Toy Story Land — Slinky Dog Dash gets the longest waits. Alien Swirling Saucers (32″ min) should work for your 4-year-old. This is the smallest park so a full day is very doable with breaks built in.

🌡️ 94°F / 73°F — Hot, feels 96°F

Crowd alert: Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets opens May 26 at HS, with cast/DVC/AP previews in the days prior — you’re visiting 6 days BEFORE the public opening surge. Toy Story Land has minimal shade — hit it at rope drop before the heat builds, and watch radar after 3 PM as wet-season storms ramp up.

Day 6 — Animal Kingdom

Thursday, May 21  |  Safari & Pandora Focus  |  Final Park Day
Rope drop Kilimanjaro Safaris — animals are most active in the cool morning. This park closes earliest, so plan a morning-heavy itinerary. After the park, you’ll head to Southwest Ranches (~3 hr drive).
👥 Crowds: 5/10 — Moderate
🌡️ 96°F / 72°F — Feels 101°F
💧 Humidity: 61%
☔ PM shower chance (32%)
💰 Day est: ~$350–450
Safari tip: Animals are most active in cooler morning temps — rope drop matters even more this trip with highs running warmer than normal. AK has the most tree cover of any park — natural shade helps. Watch radar after 3 PM; if storms threaten, Pandora’s Na’vi River and Festival of the Lion King are great indoor backups.

Wildlife Express to Affection Section

Africa → Rafiki’s Planet Watch
Catch the Wildlife Express Train at Harambe Station (just past the Gorilla Falls exit). 7-min ride to Rafiki’s Planet Watch — then walk to Affection Section, the open petting yard with goats, sheep, and pigs the kids can brush and pet. Day 6 Summary

3 rides — Kilimanjaro Safaris, Na’vi River Journey, TriceraTop Spin
2 meals — Artist’s Palette (breakfast) + Tiffins Restaurant (signature lunch)
2+ trails + petting zoo — Gorilla Falls, Affection Section (Wildlife Express train ride), Maharajah Trek, Boneyard playground

If energy allows: one more loop for forgotten souvenirs, Gideon’s cookies for the drive, or Joffrey’s coffee to-go. Skip if kids are fried — long drive is the priority.

12:00 PM — On the Road

SSR → SW Ranches

~3 hr drive south via Florida’s Turnpike
Fuel up at the Hess near SSR before merging. Turnpike is faster than I-95. Plan a kid bathroom/snack stop around Port St. Lucie (~90 min in). Afternoon thunderstorms build fast in May — earlier you’re rolling, the better.
